While this development reflects the current market environment, improving cash conversion and working capital efficiency remains a clear priority going forward. Consequently, Hydro has updated its year-end capex guiding to around NOK 12.5 billion, down from NOK 13.5 billion, and net working capital guiding to around NOK 32 billion, up from NOK 30 billion. The restart commenced in late August, marking the return of capacity curtailed during the European energy crisis in 2022. The first phase targets an annual production capacity of 75,000 tonnes by the end of February 2027. China's alumina market became increasingly oversupplied during the quarter as new refinery capacity came on line. Norwegian hydropower reservoirs were around 67.8 percent of full capacity at the end of the quarter, which is below the normal for this time of year of 82.8 percent.
